content_sections.heading: About BMC Private Sonologist
content_sections.text: The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) is the municipal corporation of Mumbai. Its Public Health Department runs Shahaji Nagar Maternity Home at Chita Camp, Mankhurd, in the M-East Ward. The Medical Officer of the maternity home issued this notice to appoint private sonologist doctors to the home's sonologist panel.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Write your application by hand and address it to the Medical Officer, Shahajinagar Maternity Home, Mankhurd (East). Hand it in with your documents at the office of Shahajinagar Maternity Home, Chita Camp, Mankhurd (East), Mumbai. Check that you meet the qualification, experience, registration and age conditions listed below. Write your application in your own handwriting, addressed to the Medical Officer, Shahajinagar Maternity Home, Mankhurd (East). Attach your documents to the application. Hand the application and documents in at the office of Shahajinagar Maternity Home, between 10.00 am and 6.00 pm (18.00), from 21 October 2026 to 3 November 2026. The office does not take applications on the weekly holiday. The notice does not list the documents one by one. Based on the eligibility conditions, these are the documents it names: Post-graduate degree, diploma or DNB in the concerned subject Proof of 1 year of experience after the post-graduate degree Maharashtra Medical Council registration certificate and renewal certificate Maharashtra Council registration or renewal certificate for any additional qualification FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The only post is Private Sonologist, a doctor on the sonologist panel of Shahajinagar Maternity Home. The vacancy count is 1 (the notice does not print a number). You must hold a post-graduate degree, diploma or DNB in the concerned subject (संबंधित विषयातील पदव्युत्तर पदवी/पदविका/डीएनबी). You must have 1 year of experience after getting your post-graduate degree. You need a certificate of registration with the Maharashtra Medical Council and a certificate of its renewal. Any additional qualification also needs a certificate of registration or renewal with the Maharashtra Council. Doctors on the sonologist panel can be up to 65 years old. The notice does not give an "as on" date for age. The notice calls the pay a proposed honorarium (प्रस्तावित मानधन). content_sections.text: Each maternity home should have at least two experts on its sonologist panel. Only interested sonologists who meet all the conditions above should apply.
